subject: [PATCH v5 10/11] mm, swap: defer memcg_table allocation for physical swap clusters

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch optimizes memory allocation for physical swap clusters by deferring the allocation of a memcg table until it is actually needed. This reduces unnecessary memory usage in cases where a cluster only holds vswap backings, which do not require a memcg table. The patch modifies the swap_cluster_alloc_table function to allocate the memcg table eagerly only when the cluster is known to be used for direct mapping or when vswap is disabled.
